tasks.short: Run pension, insurance and savings schemes: changes to carriers, check their invoices and data, answer questions.

today.trigger: Monthly payroll close, joiners and leavers in AFAS, carrier invoices and broker mails, employee questions.
steps: Export joiners, leavers, salary and hours changes from AFAS Profit
Upload or key changes into the pension fund and insurer portals
Reconcile carrier invoices and member lists against AFAS in Excel
Chase differences with the broker or carrier by mail
Answer employee and manager questions on pension and insurance
drudgery: Line-by-line matching of carrier lists to AFAS
Retyping the same changes into several portals
Answering the same pension question again
today.time_sinks: Monthly reconciliation of carrier invoices and member data, and chasing mismatches that come from late AFAS changes.

lenses.faster: A scripted monthly match of AFAS against each carrier file replaces the Excel reconciliation; only the mismatches reach the specialist.
lenses.autonomous: An AFAS mutation (join, leave, salary, part-time change) triggers the carrier change file and a check that the carrier processed it.
lenses.ambitious: Every employee gets a correct, personal overview of pension, insurance and savings in Dutch, English and Polish, also for the 2027 move to the new pension scheme.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses ticking lists; what stays is helping people with real choices, such as partner pension or part-time retirement.
lenses.options: For a scheme change the specialist can model three to five carrier or contribution variants with cost and employee impact side by side.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the data contract between AFAS and the carriers and the rules for exceptions instead of doing the matching.
reach: Payroll Specialist: pension and insurance deductions checked before payroll close
Bookkeeper: carrier invoice matching to the ledger

tasks.human_edge: Judging an odd case (long-term illness, divorce, cross-border worker), negotiating with brokers, and explaining a pension choice to someone worried about it.
tasks.pattern_why: Carrier data and invoices are structured and checkable against AFAS; rules can be written down and run without a model. Questions on fund documents can sit on top as a gated agent.

in_practice.trigger: AFAS mutation or monthly payroll close; carrier invoice arrives.
steps: Pull changes from AFAS via its connector into the matching script
Generate carrier change files and compare carrier lists and invoices to AFAS
Route mismatches to an exception list with the probable cause
Specialist resolves exceptions and approves the invoice for payment
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist approves each exception and the monthly invoice before AP pays it.
data_needed: AFAS employee, contract and salary data
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint exceptions log per month, with approval and resolution.

evidence.claim: Carrier data reconciliation is best run as deterministic software at high autonomy; pension questions as an agent citing fund documents.
Pensioenfonds Vervoer expects its new scheme on 1 January 2027, which adds transition questions and data changes.
AFAS Profit exposes connectors for reading and writing employee data.

risks: Sending wrong personal data to a carrier (AVG/GDPR breach)
Script silently breaks when a carrier changes its file format
Over-trusting the match and missing a scheme rule change
research_questions: How many hours a month go to carrier reconciliation today, and how many mismatches per month?
Do our carriers accept structured change files or API, or only portal entry?
Are Noordhaven's drivers actually in Pensioenfonds Vervoer, and which other schemes apply?

tasks.short: Grade a new or changed job: which function group, CAO or above-CAO, overtime rules, salary scale.

today.trigger: Manager asks for a new role, a role changes, or a recruiter needs a band for a vacancy.
steps: Collect the job description and talk to the manager
Compare with existing jobs in the CAO grid or the own job system
Score the job and pick a function group and scale
Decide CAO or above-CAO status and allowances
Write the grading memo and update AFAS
drudgery: Writing the same memo structure each time
today.time_sinks: Getting a usable job description from the manager and finding comparable jobs across three sites.

lenses.faster: An LLM turns the manager's notes into a standard description and a per-factor draft score with reasons and the three closest existing jobs.
lenses.autonomous: A new vacancy request in Recruitee without a graded job triggers the draft and puts it in the specialist's queue.
lenses.ambitious: Every job at all three sites is graded on the four pay transparency factors with a written reason, ready for the works council and the 2028 report.
lenses.joy: No more chasing descriptions and copying memo text; what stays is the judgement call and the conversation with the manager.
lenses.options: The draft shows two or three plausible groups with what would have to be true for each, so the discussion is about facts.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the job architecture and grading rules and checks drafts, instead of grading one by one.
reach: Recruiter: bands for vacancies before negotiation
HR Business Partner: first-pass role design for reorganisations
People Analytics: job data quality in AFAS

tasks.human_edge: The grade decision, reading what the job really is on the warehouse floor, and defending it to manager, employee and works council.
tasks.pattern_why: Unstructured description in, structured per-factor score with reasons out, checked by the specialist inside a fixed grading workflow.

in_practice.trigger: New or changed job request in Recruitee or by mail.
steps: LLM standardises the description against the job template
LLM scores each factor (skills, responsibility, effort, working conditions) with reasons and nearest comparable jobs
Specialist reviews, adjusts and decides group and status
Decision and reasons are written to AFAS job scheme and the job register
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist decides each grade; CAO jobs stay in the CAO system.
systems: Microsoft 365 Copilot or a hosted LLM
in_practice.logs_to: Job register on SharePoint with draft, final grade, reviewer and reason, kept for the AI Act and pay transparency.

evidence.claim: ChatGPT models scored 50 job descriptions per HERA factor with over 70% agreement with experts.
AFAS Profit 8 stores job schemes and categories as preparation for pay transparency.
Grade recommendations can fall under AI Act Annex III 4(b), high-risk from 2 December 2027.

risks: About 30% of drafts wrong; a wrong grade becomes an unexplained pay difference
Annex III high-risk duties: oversight, logs, informing the works council
Regrading on every small change instead of material change
research_questions: On 20 past gradings, how often does the draft match the final grade?
Which jobs fall under the CAO grid and which under an own system needing works council consent?
Will the CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer sector regrading change our grid, and when?

tasks.short: Research benefit and safety practices elsewhere and propose changes to our policies.

today.trigger: New law, CAO change, works council question, absence trend, or annual policy review.
steps: Search sources, sector bodies and peer companies
Read current Noordhaven policies on SharePoint
Compare costs and practice in Excel
Write a recommendation note for the HR Director
drudgery: Reading long legal and sector texts
today.time_sinks: Finding and reading reliable sources and mapping them against our own policies.

lenses.faster: A research assistant summarises sources with citations and marks where our SharePoint policy differs.
lenses.autonomous: Law and CAO updates are watched and a short gap note is drafted when something changes.
lenses.ambitious: Each policy gets a yearly evidence check against law, CAO and absence data, not only when something breaks.
lenses.joy: Less reading of dense texts; more time on what fits our shift workers.
lenses.options: Three policy variants with cost, employee effect and works council route.
lenses.altitude: The specialist runs a policy review calendar and checks the assistant's sources instead of doing all the reading.
reach: HR Director: policy proposals ready for the board
Health and safety staff: benefit side of safety measures
HR Business Partner: input for works council talks

tasks.human_edge: Knowing what works on our sites, weighing cost against goodwill, and selling the change to the works council.
tasks.pattern_why: Open-ended research and recommendation; the specialist leads and AI drafts and summarises.

in_practice.trigger: Policy review date, law or CAO change, or a question from HR Director or works council.
steps: Assistant gathers sources and summarises with citations
Assistant compares with current policy and absence data
Specialist checks sources and picks the direction
Assistant drafts the note; specialist edits and sends
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist checks every cited source before the note leaves HR.
systems: Microsoft 365 Copilot or LLM with web search
data_needed: Absence and cost data from Power BI
in_practice.logs_to: Policy file on SharePoint with sources and version.

evidence.claim: LLM research assistants summarise and cite sources for policy work.

risks: US-centred practice that does not fit Dutch law
research_questions: How many policy notes a year and hours each?
Does the HR Director trust AI-summarised sources after a check of five notes?

tasks.short: Answer managers and staff on CAO, pay rules, allowances, benefits and grading.

today.trigger: Mail, Teams message or call from a manager or employee.
steps: Read the question and find the employee's situation in AFAS
Look up CAO, policy or regulation
Write or give the answer
Follow up if it needs a decision
drudgery: Repeat questions on shift allowances, travel cost, holiday pay
Looking up the same CAO article
today.time_sinks: Many small repeat questions interrupting other work.

lenses.faster: A drafted answer citing the CAO article and policy is ready when the specialist opens the question.
lenses.autonomous: Standard questions get an answer from a Teams assistant that says it is AI; unusual or personal ones go to the specialist.
lenses.ambitious: Every employee, including flex workers and Polish-speaking staff, gets a correct answer in their own language within a day.
lenses.joy: Fewer repeats; more time on questions that really need advice.
lenses.options: For a manager's case, the assistant sets out two or three ways the rules allow, with cost.
lenses.altitude: The specialist curates the knowledge base and reviews escalated and sampled answers.
reach: HR Business Partner: manager rule checks

tasks.human_edge: Questions with personal stakes or conflict, and judging when a rule should bend.
tasks.pattern_why: Several steps (classify, look up, draft, route) over documents and AFAS; standard answers go out, others need approval.

in_practice.trigger: Question in a Teams channel or HR mailbox.
steps: Agent classifies the question and checks it is standard
Agent retrieves CAO, policy and needed AFAS data
Agent drafts an answer with citations
Specialist approves non-standard drafts; standard ones sent with AI notice
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist approves anything personal, financial or outside the knowledge base; weekly sample review.
in_practice.logs_to: Question log with answer, sources and approver on SharePoint.

evidence.claim: A benefits chatbot must disclose it is AI (Art. 50).
Pay requests can be answered by agent with gate at autonomy 3.

risks: Wrong answer read as a commitment
Personal data shown to the wrong person
research_questions: What share of questions are repeats of a top 30?
Does the works council want consultation before a staff-facing assistant?
How accurate are drafts on 50 past questions?

tasks.short: Design and run the yearly merit round and bonus schemes for above-CAO staff.

today.trigger: Annual merit cycle, budget round, or new incentive request.
steps: Pull salaries and ratings from AFAS into Excel
Set budget and guidelines with Finance
Send sheets to managers and collect proposals
Check against budget and fairness
Load approved changes into AFAS
today.time_sinks: Collecting and merging manager input and checking fairness by hand.

lenses.faster: Sheets, budget checks and gap checks are generated; the specialist reviews outliers.
lenses.autonomous: Reminders and budget checks run on their own during the cycle.
lenses.ambitious: Every proposal is checked for gender and group pay gap before approval, ready for the pay transparency report.
lenses.joy: No merging spreadsheets; time for coaching managers on fair decisions.
lenses.options: Three to five budget allocation scenarios with effect on gap and retention.
lenses.altitude: The specialist designs the merit rules and fairness checks rather than running the sheets.

tasks.human_edge: Setting what is fair, handling managers, and owning the outcome; GDPR Art. 22 bars model-only pay decisions.
tasks.pattern_why: Program design and pay decisions stay with people; AI does scenarios, checks and drafts.

steps: Generate manager input forms from AFAS data
Run budget and gap checks on proposals
Assistant drafts outlier notes and scenarios
Specialist and HR Director decide; upload to AFAS
in_practice.human_gate: Managers and HR Director approve every pay change.
in_practice.logs_to: Merit file on SharePoint with proposals, checks and approvals.

evidence.claim: 58% of employers pay or plan an AI-skill premium; the rules are unsettled.
GDPR Art. 22 bars a pay decision made solely by a model.

risks: Recommendations seen as high-risk AI under Annex III
research_questions: How many staff are above-CAO and in the merit round?
How many hours does the cycle take today?

tasks.short: Advise on complaints about grading or salary, and prepare the case for the objection committee.

today.trigger: Employee or manager objects to a grade or salary.
steps: Collect the file: job description, grading, pay history
Talk to employee and manager
Compare with similar jobs
Write advice for the HR Director or committee
today.time_sinks: Rebuilding the history of a grade and finding comparisons.

lenses.faster: The case file and comparison table are assembled from AFAS and the job register in minutes.
lenses.autonomous: Not autonomous; a complaint opens a case and the file is prepared for the specialist.
lenses.ambitious: Every complaint is answered with documented reasons within the two-month pay transparency term.
lenses.joy: Less file hunting; more time to listen.
lenses.options: Assistant drafts the strongest arguments for and against the complaint.
lenses.altitude: The specialist uses complaint patterns to fix the grading rules.

tasks.human_edge: Trust, hearing the person, and a defensible decision; the earlier 'automate' score is set aside because complaints are sensitive.
tasks.pattern_why: Disputed decisions about a person's pay need a human lead; AI only prepares files and drafts.

steps: Assemble the case file and comparisons
Assistant drafts a neutral summary and arguments
Specialist talks to parties and writes the advice
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist and committee decide; nothing goes to the employee without review.

evidence.claim: Complaints should be treated as human-led.
Pay requests must be answered within two months under the transparency bill.

risks: Employee feels judged by a machine
research_questions: How many complaints a year really reach the specialist?
Would the works council accept AI-prepared files?

tasks.short: Write job descriptions, maintain the job grid and salary scales.

today.trigger: New job, reorganisation, CAO wage increase, or annual scale review.
steps: Draft or update descriptions in Word
Place jobs in the grid
Recalculate scales after CAO raises or market data
Update AFAS and SharePoint
today.time_sinks: Keeping hundreds of descriptions consistent and current.

lenses.faster: Descriptions drafted from a template and manager input; scales recalculated by script.
lenses.autonomous: A CAO raise updates all scale tables and AFAS for review.
lenses.ambitious: A complete, consistent job architecture on four factors for all 1,200 staff and flex roles.
lenses.options: Several scale structures modelled with cost and gap effect.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the job architecture and its evidence.

tasks.human_edge: Choosing the structure, works council consent, and judging job content.
tasks.pattern_why: Drafting descriptions from notes is an LLM step; scale maths is deterministic.

steps: LLM drafts description from template
Script recalculates scales
Specialist reviews and approves
Publish to AFAS and SharePoint
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist approves; works council consents to the system.

evidence.claim: 61% of employers rewrite job descriptions for AI; 49% say salary structures lag.
Works council consent needed for a pay or grading system unless the CAO settles it.

research_questions: Which scales are own and which CAO?

tasks.short: Cost CAO proposals and wage scenarios for negotiations and budget.

steps: Extract AFAS payroll data
Build Excel cost model
Run scenarios
Present to HR and Finance Directors
today.time_sinks: Re-running scenarios when proposals change mid-talks.

lenses.faster: A reusable cost model gives new scenarios in minutes.
lenses.autonomous: Model refreshes nightly with AFAS data.
lenses.ambitious: Every proposal costed live during talks, including flex workers.
lenses.altitude: The specialist maintains the model and assumptions.

tasks.human_edge: Choosing assumptions and reading the negotiation.
tasks.pattern_why: Costing is rule-based on structured data.

steps: Load AFAS extract
Apply scenario parameters
Output cost by group and year
Specialist checks and presents

evidence.claim: CAO costing is best as deterministic software.
Compa Analyst Agent drafts market-pricing findings.

research_questions: How often do scenarios change during talks?
Can agencies supply flex pay data?

role.altitude: From grading jobs and checking carrier lists one by one to owning Noordhaven's job architecture, benefits data flows and the evidence behind every pay difference.
reach: HR Administrator: first-line pay and benefits questions
role.ceiling_note: About 40% of time can be freed; the limit is judgement, works council consent, AI Act high-risk duties for grading and pay, and person-to-person work on complaints and negotiations.
skills_to_grow: Pay transparency law and job evaluation on four factors
Designing and testing rules and AI drafts
Data skills in AFAS connectors and Power BI
Explaining pay decisions to works council and staff
role.ambitious_version: Noordhaven's first pay transparency report over 2027 shows no unexplained 5% gap, every job is graded with written reasons, and every employee and flex worker can get a correct answer about their pay and pension within days.
